headline: Public Safety Committee heard trespass appeal of Scott Martin, then moved into Deliberative Session
summary: The committee held a hearing on the trespass appeal of Scott Martin, hearing testimony from City Attorney Jessica Brown on behalf of Chocolate Thunder and from Martin himself. Mikey Van Gulden of Chocolate Thunder also gave testimony with images and video during public forum. After questioning the appellant, the committee moved into Deliberative Session, and the meeting ended without a recorded decision on the appeal.
